name: Zhentarim Tactics

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: After a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against it. Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, changed after each Long Rest.

benefits.name: Hit Back
benefits.summary: After a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against it.
benefits.text: When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to make an Opportunity Attack against it.

benefits.name: Trade Secrets
benefits.summary: Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, changed after each Long Rest.
benefits.text: Choose a skill you're proficient in: you have Expertise with it. The book lets you choose again after each Long Rest; in the game you choose when you take the feat and can change it when you gain a level.
